steps.caption: You play White against the board
steps.shows: Starting position, 'You're White. Tap a piece to move it.', Menu button

steps.caption: Menu: Back, the level (Easy, Medium, Hard), your tally, Undo and New game
steps.shows: Panel open under the board: Back, Easy selected, Medium, Hard, 'Won 2 Drawn 0 Lost 2', Close, Undo (greyed), New game

steps.caption: Tap a piece: its moves show as dots
steps.shows: Menu closed, e2 pawn on a black square with dots on e3 and e4; 'Now tap where it goes.'

steps.caption: Tap where it goes; the board thinks, then plays its move
steps.shows: Pawn on e4; the board played Nc6 (from and to squares framed): 'The board played Nc6. Your move.'

steps.caption: A capture shows as corners on the piece you can take
steps.shows: Queen on f3 picked: dots for its moves, corners on the black knight on e4 and the pawn on f7

steps.caption: Take it; captured pieces line up above and below the board
steps.shows: Queen took the knight on e4; the board played d5; a captured knight shown under the board

steps.caption: Check: your king gets a thick frame
steps.shows: A later game: 'The board played Qxh4+. Check!' with the white king on f2 thickly framed

steps.caption: Checkmate wins the game; New game starts another
steps.shows: 'Checkmate. You win!' after Qh8#; the black king thickly framed; New game button filled
